rootCause.diagnosis: Ten concurrent classifier calls exhausted the configured gpt-4o token-per-minute limit. The Brain did not catch the provider's 429, so FastAPI exposed each exception as a blank HTTP 500.

correction.brainBehavior: Return a reasoned HTTP 429 with reason rate_limited and do not retry automatically.
correction.classifierTransport: Disable the OpenAI SDK's implicit retries, allow one provider attempt for up to 90 seconds, and return explicit reasons for rate-limit, timeout, connection, and provider-status failures.
correction.evaluationBehavior: Use one worker, space request starts by four seconds by default, make one attempt per case, and report transport failures separately from exact semantic mismatches.

finalAcceptanceRun.finding: Concurrency 2 still exceeded the same 30000 token-per-minute provider limit, but the Brain returned explicit HTTP 429 responses rather than blank 500s. The reusable evaluator now defaults to one worker; the failed requests were not retried.
